snippet.title: Trainwatch - Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Trainwatch: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864940/Trainwatch/

A psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. What seems like a simple one-month job as a gatekeeper manning the crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folks, and trying to fix your own life.

🚨 Coming March 10th, 2027
🎮 Sign Up for the Playtest Now

Trainwatch is developed by Remigiusz "Rem" Michalski (Harvester Games), the mind behind The Cat Lady, Downfall, Lorelai, and Burnhouse Lane, and published by 11 bit studios.

Trainwatch Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864940/Trainwatch/

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
